text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Almond Eye!!
The strongest active Umamusume stands before us!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I gave it everything I had!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: This feels great!
Feels great, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...She really is amazing after all.
And she's the one...
we have to defeat..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...want to...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I want to race her... Eye-senpai...! Ah, geez, I'm itching to go!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan...
Are you not scared at all?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I mean—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose in the mile.
—Not even to Ai-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Can't be helped, huh.
You did great going up against a monster like that.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...As if!
Like I'd ever think that...!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh............!
Today of all days, I wanted to win...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!
If it's come to this...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san!
Hold on a second!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm not lettin' ya run off after winning like that...!
I'm—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
――I totally get it!!
You want to race together again, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Your drive—determined to beat me, wanting to beat me, believing you would...
It was truly thrilling...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you can get even stronger, can't you!?
I know you can—we're rivals, after all!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lala, it's a promise!
You have to come back! For a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Did you really have to go and say every single thing?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I really, honestly...
can't stand this..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Alright, alright! Ice packs coming up!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, looking forward to working with... wait, no!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Let's decide on the next race!
As soon as possible, right this instant!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
As for upcoming GⅠ races...
Would it be the Yasuda Kinen or the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Consecutive mile races, or the Spring Grand Prix...
Either is fine by me, or even both!
choice_data_list: Aiming for both might be a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be riding an incredible high.
If we can channel this momentum in the right direction to achieve her goal of winning lots of GⅠs—
choice_data_list: ...The Yasuda Kinen, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Yasuda Kinen is considered the race that decides the spring mile champion. Since it's the same distance as today's race, she should be able to maintain good momentum. Besides—"
choice_data_list: It's better for you if it's as cool as possible, after all.
It's better for you if it's as cool as possible, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It's not that I'm weak to the heat! It just takes me longer to recover than in other seasons!
...Probably.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still, I understand. Next up is the Yasuda Kinen, right!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
just one more month until the next race...!
choice_data_list: ...Isn't the interval a bit too short, honestly?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then there's nothing to worry about!
My body's much stronger than before, and I don't have a fever, see?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do is make the right adjustments!
And that is—
choice_data_list: That's my job.
That's my job.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please do!
I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While Almond Eye packs up to head home,
I take a stroll and think about how to adjust our training.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Ai is the strongest?
Ehh~~, you're exaggerating way too much~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I mean, look at Ai-chan winning so much! That totally means she's super strong, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Think about it logically, okay? She's only won so much because she's running at a crazy pace.
She's not like the other truly strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
If it were a different era, I wouldn't have won this much!
So in my book, I'm not the strongest. Nope.
The truly strongest is—
choice_data_list: (...Even though I've won against such amazing girls...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...What's wrong?
You look so grim!
choice_data_list: ...Because I was thinking about the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh...! You were being serious.
Let me know once you've gathered your thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her smile, I think to myself:
I need everyone to realize, undeniably and
conclusively, just how strong Almond Eye is.
choice_data_list: (—To carve my name into history)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, have you made up your mind?
You had the whole night, so surely you're ready!
choice_data_list: Of course...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, a strange feeling came over me.
Something about Almond Eye seemed just a tiny bit off.
choice_data_list: —Ai, got a minute?
—Ai, do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Just as you pointed out, Trainer,
symptoms of heatstroke are starting to appear.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
It's fortunate we caught it early.
With some rest, it will heal.
Please refrain from strenuous exercise for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't notice at all.
choice_data_list: Maybe I was running on adrenaline.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I wish I had noticed.
If we had kept training just like this today...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I'm truly so glad you were here with me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—So I'm fine!
I'm going to run in the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She had already realized. There was too little time before the race compared to what she needed to recover. So, I tried to suggest taking it off her list of goals, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm having so much fun!
More than I've ever had before!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Running so many races... winning so many times!
With the next one right around the corner, I can push even harder—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —It'll keep me happy forever!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
More, more...
I want to win... even more!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You won't take it from me, right?
I'm sure you understand by now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye's gleaming gaze...
The sheer intensity of her obsession with victory reflected within it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's been a while since a shiver ran down my spine... but that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That's right, Trainer...! I can do anything, because—
choice_data_list: That is how wonderful... the joy of victory is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path to choose is already decided, and I am prepared to support her all the way.
If so, then right now, so she doesn't overthink things—
choice_data_list: It's okay, together we can do anything!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, what a weird way to put it!
Geez, you made me laugh.
choice_data_list: Relax your shoulders and let's enjoy this.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...Thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after thorough consultation with the school nurse,
we decided on a training menu leading up to the Yasuda Kinen.
...I had to support her so she could reach it safely.
